packageRules.description: reqwest/argon2/oauth2 major bumps tend to break compilation or change password-hashing behavior; keep them out of the routine cargo group so one breaking bump doesn't block everything else.

reqwest 0.13 renames the rustls-tls feature bichon-core depends on and is incompatible with oauth2 5.0's vendored reqwest 0.12 (oauth2::reqwest::ClientBuilder types won't unify with a 0.13 Client/Proxy) — held back until oauth2 supports reqwest 0.13. See commit 49997cb.

argon2 0.6 moves PasswordHash/SaltString into password-hash's new phc module and makes hash_password generic, breaking crates/core/src/users/mod.rs and utils/totp.rs — needs a manual port before adopting. See commit 49997cb.

native_db 0.8.2 (current latest release) hard-pins native_model =0.4.20 exactly (not just <0.6.0); any other version, including 0.5.0, creates two native_model versions in the graph and breaks the native_model::Model trait bound on #[native_db] structs in crates/admin/src/meta.rs. See commit 49997cb and PR #22.

npm majors were being bundled into the routine 'web dependencies' group and merged without review; PR #25 bundled 10 majors at once and broke tsc -b (see commit reverting web/package.json, and the docker.yml build failures it caused). Keep majors in their own group so a breaking one doesn't ride in silently with patches.

v9 is not a drop-in replacement: react-table renames getCoreRowModel/getFacetedRowModel/etc to createXRowModel and changes ColumnDef/Table/Row generic arity (breaks src/features/users/**/components/*.tsx); x-tree-view drops the TreeViewBaseItem export used by src/lib/build-tree.ts. Broke docker.yml's tsc -b via PR #25; reverted in commit 630ec76. Needs a manual port before adopting.
Held at 7.x alongside @mui/x-tree-view 8.x, which it must stay in lockstep with. See commit 630ec76 (PR #25 revert).

zod 4 removes the invalid_type_error param option used in src/features/users/users/components/access-token-action.tsx in favor of a different error-customization API. See commit 630ec76 (PR #25 revert).
